series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept for reused items; new items classified by the complete visible contrast; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified.

primarySources.use: Stem + 切る: complete, to the end; 'utterly' with state verbs; N3 lesson 9
Stem + 切れない: cannot do completely; N3 lesson 9
Stem + 込む: movement into; N3 lesson 9
Stem + 込む: deeply, thoroughly, a state sets in; N3 lesson 9
Stem + 上がる／上げる: completion, intransitive and transitive; N3 lesson 9
Stem + 合う: mutual action; N3 lesson 3
Level of 出す (N4, onset sense) for the outward contrast side

supplementarySources.supports: N3 placement of 〜通す (grammar #150 per plan); page not fetched (captcha)
N3 placement of 〜通す per the series plan (Rule B); not re-inspected
Lexicalised stem compounds; contrasting uses of 込む (already cited by verb-extensions-direction-and-aspect.md)

dispositions.note: Four 合う targets; two one-way targets (てもらう／てあげる, Bunpro N4) labelled N3 by the complete-contrast rule.
Completion sense only; the upward sense (見上げる) is article-only.
Completion and firm-statement (言い切る) senses; 'utterly' (冷え切る, 疲れ切る) is article-only.
Contrasted with 切る and with 通す; 切れず accepted where the て-form is asked.

Formed against outward 出す (dasu-out, Bunpro N4 for onset 出す; labelled N3 by the complete-contrast rule) and interpreted against 込む②. The dasu-out contrast targets (library-books-out, dog-escape) are listed here because they exist only as the contrast side of this row.
Practised by interpretation only (the compound is supplied); learners type 中へ or 深く.

dispositions.levelEvidence: not listed by Bunpro (page 404); Sensei #150 and SKM N3 per plan (Rule B); Sensei page not fetched (captcha)

groups.reason: Done completely or not (切る／切れない)
Kept up to the end or not (通す／切れない)
Into or out of a place (込む／出す)
Something gets finished or someone finishes it (上がる／上げる)
Done to each other or one way (合う)

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

findings.claim: Only kana spellings of the auxiliaries もらう／あげる were accepted.
findings.change: 貰った／貰って and 上げて spellings are now also accepted.

findings.claim: The rationale 'it does not say someone talked for them' mischaracterised 話してもらう.
findings.change: Rationale now: 話してもらう has someone receive another's speaking, rather than everyone exchanging opinions.

findings.claim: Once the instruction named 〜てあげる, 兄に教えてあげた was also a correct reading.
findings.change: Prompt now fixes the direction (私は分からない問題があったので、兄に____。／兄のおかげで、やっと解けた。); every other item in the group was checked and fixed for the same ambiguity.

findings.claim: The 合う vs benefactive bullet misstated which particle marks the giver.
findings.change: Now: use てもらう (giver に), てあげる (receiver に) or てくれる (giver が).

reviews.finalVerdict: CLEAN after reconciliation; one rule gap accepted by the coordinator

findings.claim: The hints glossed the whole compound, giving the answer away.
findings.change: Hints gloss the parts (書く write + 込む); explanations give the whole-compound meaning.

findings.claim: Completion was inferred only from ので.
findings.change: An explicit completion sentence was added before the gap.

findings.claim: The context did not exclude 話してもらう, and the rationale claimed there was no receiver.
findings.change: Context now has every family member give an opinion; the no-receiver claim was removed.

findings.claim: Inflection predicted the key (for example negatives always in て-form).
findings.change: Inflections re-crossed and 5 new items added so each inflection carries both keys.
findings.disposition: resolved, except that the plain nonpast in mutual-or-one-way carries only the one-way key (accepted by the coordinator)

findings.claim: The とても hint '(not) possibly' gave away the negative.
findings.change: Hint now 'very; (with a negative) at all'.

findings.claim: お互いに does not exclude reciprocal benefactives such as 助けてあげる.
findings.change: No 合う-keyed item relies on お互いに. language-exchange and exam-friends were redesigned; neighbours-help was dropped after a redesign was still contested; 合う keeps 3 targets.

findings.claim: Same as CVE-B-05: the hint revealed the negative.
The article named only てもらう and てあげる, but items also use てくれる.
findings.change: てくれる added to the prose, the table, Common confusions and Levels.
